definitions.exactTransportCoveredMs: union of exact-lane physical RPC intervals clipped to each Solver wall window; not a sum across overlapping requests
definitions.notCoveredByExactTransportMs: unattributed remainder; includes local work, scheduling, other I/O and cancellation/drain; NOT asserted to be CPU time
definitions.limitations: unpaired live diagnostic; cancelled/failed blocks retained; route wall timing exists only in second snapshot
